summary_rationale: BrightSpring Health Services (BTSG) continues to execute a disciplined post-LBO transformation into an independent specialty pharmacy (Onco360/CareMed/PharMerica) and home/community clinical care platform. Verified Q3 2026 Form 10-Q results show 9M 2026 continuing revenue grew +25.0% YoY to $11,700.1M (Q3 $4,213.2M, +26.4%) and Adjusted EBITDA rose +43.5% YoY to $623.0M, backing raised FY2026 guidance of $15.9B-$16.125B revenue and $850M-$860M Adjusted EBITDA. Core KPIs remain strong: Pharmacy GP/script hit $28.86 (+26.8% YoY in Q3), Home Health ADC surged +57.6% YoY to 47,256, Onco360 extended its 155+ LDD franchise (MIMRYLO in Sept 2026), net leverage dropped to 1.79x after May 2026's $300M paydown and Tranche B-6 repricing (SOFR + 2.00%), and CMS's Nov 9, 2026 CY 2027 Home Health Final Rule delivered a +2.4% (+$415M) net rate increase. Pass-1 blind-spot forensics support keeping kpi_health at PASS_WITH_WATCH due to: (1) 68.2% government payor concentration and escalating IRA Part D pressure in Home & Community (-$138.0M or -7.9% YoY in 9M 2026), compounded by CMS's Nov 19, 2026 CRUSH fraud/EVV oversight proposed rule and ongoing qui tam/drug-tariff risks; (2) $111.6M of new off-balance-sheet supplier consignment inventory, negative working-capital reliance (AP $1,232.3M > AR $1,216.4M), and standalone ABDC/Cencora wholesaler dependence; (3) Provider Services SG&A inflation (+38.0% YoY in 9M keeping segment margin flat at 15.8%), $1.21B unhedged floating-rate debt (-$12.1M per +1% SOFR), 9M GAAP tax rate depressed to 14.4% by $33.0M discrete SBC tax benefits (vs 25.4% underlying), and rising liability/health/legal reserves; and (4) remaining KKR governance rights (26.83M shares / 13.6%, Stockholders Agreement board seats, classified board) alongside $120.0M of concurrent 2026 buybacks.
